posts.quote: I tasted the gravy six times to check the salt. Now I'm full, and the gravy is still wrong.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with black bold text. Text reads: I tasted the gravy six times to check the salt. Now I'm full, and the gravy is still wrong.

posts.quote: I SLEPT IN UNTIL 6:40 TODAY. I'M TELLING EVERYONE I WAS AWAY.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with a grey-streaked messy bun with a pencil in it and glasses pushed up on her head, in an olive vest over a striped shirt, sitting up in a rumpled bed holding a wine glass and a coffee mug with a smug half-smile, a bedside clock reading 6:40. Text at the top reads: I slept in until 6:40 today. I'm telling everyone I was away.

posts.quote: My son called it 'a quick favor.' It's hour six, and the favor now has its own shed.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with black bold text. Text reads: My son called it 'a quick favor.' It's hour six, and the favor now has its own shed.

posts.quote: SIX PEOPLE ASKED IF THEY COULD HELP IN THE KITCHEN. NOT ONE OF THEM OFFERED TO LEAVE IT.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a plus-size woman with a huge halo of copper curls, round glasses and a bold geometric tunic, holding one palm out in a stop gesture and a wine glass in the other hand in a crowded Thanksgiving kitchen with a roast turkey and steaming pots, while three smiling relatives crowd around her. Text at the top reads: Six people asked if they could help in the kitchen. Not one of them offered to leave it.

posts.quote: The vet asked if my cat is overweight. I said she's big-boned. He looked at me, then at her, then wrote something down.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with black bold text. Text reads: The vet asked if my cat is overweight. I said she's big-boned. He looked at me, then at her, then wrote something down.

posts.quote: I TURNED DOWN THREE INVITATIONS THIS WEEK. I FELT GUILTY FOR FOUR SECONDS, THEN THE KETTLE WENT OFF.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a barefoot woman with silver-white wavy hair, lavender round glasses and an oatmeal cardigan, sitting at a kitchen table with a cup of tea and her chin on her hand, a phone face down on the table and a steaming kettle on the stove behind her. Text at the top reads: I turned down three invitations this week. I felt guilty for four seconds, then the kettle went off.

posts.quote: The best meal of the whole holiday is the turkey sandwich I eat at 10 p.m., standing in the refrigerator light.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with black bold text. Text reads: The best meal of the whole holiday is the turkey sandwich I eat at 10 p.m., standing in the refrigerator light.

stories.quote: THE PIE'S BEEN COOLING FOR AN HOUR. I'VE WALKED PAST IT NINE TIMES. I'M NOT HUNGRY. I'M SUPERVISING.
stories.alt: Cartoon illustration of a full-figured woman with short dusty mauve-pink curls, a mustard fairisle sweater, lavender pants and pink fluffy slippers, standing in a cozy kitchen with arms crossed and a wine glass, eyeing a steaming pumpkin pie cooling on a rack. Text at the top reads: The pie's been cooling for an hour. I've walked past it nine times. I'm not hungry. I'm supervising.

stories.quote: AT 3 A.M. MY BRAIN REPLAYED EVERYTHING AWKWARD I'VE SAID SINCE 1994. IT'S THOROUGH. I'LL GIVE IT THAT.
stories.alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with a grey-streaked messy bun with a pencil in it, in an olive vest and striped shirt, lying awake in a dark bedroom with a clock reading 3:00 AM, thought clouds above her showing small cringing versions of herself, a wine glass on the nightstand. Text at the top reads: At 3 a.m. my brain replayed everything awkward I've said since 1994. It's thorough. I'll give it that.
